arabic text: CHEHRA HAI ZALIMON KA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: What all did Ali witness within Zahra's tears? The faces of the oppressors are reflected in Zahra's tears.

arabic text: IN TOOTI PASLIYO’n KA KYU’n EK MAA KO GHAM HO\nJO GHAM HAI FATIMA KA WOH KIS TARHA RAQAM HO\nMOHSIN KA HAI JANAZA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: Why should a mother grieve only over these broken ribs?\nHow can Fatima's sorrow ever be written?\nMohsin's funeral lies within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: QUNFUZ KO HAATH UTHATE DEKHA JAHAN HASAN NE\nMAA KO TAMACHE KHATE DEKHA JAHAAN HASAN NE\nHAI AAJ BHI WOH RASTA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: Hasan saw Qunfuz raise his hand;\nHasan saw his mother struck with a slap.\nEven today, that street remains within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: GHURBAT ME FATEMA KE HUJRE ME JO RAKHA HAI\nABBAS KE LIYE JO EK HAATH SE SIYA BAI\nMAUJOOD HAI WO KURTA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: In Fatima's exile, within her small room,\nthere is a shirt sewn with one hand for Abbas.\nThat shirt remains present within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: ZAHRA KE HAATH ZAKHMI DEKHE TO SABR TOOTA\nIS GHAM ME MURTAZA BHI RONE LAGE JO DEKHA\nZALIM KA TAAZIYANA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: When he saw Zahra's wounded hands, his patience broke.\nIn this grief Murtaza too began to weep,\nseeing the tyrant's whip within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: HAAYE GHAREEB E ZAHRA JISKO KAHAA GAYA HAI\nUTH UTH KE FATIMA SE PAANI JO MANGTA HAI\nHAI WOH HUSSAIN PYASA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: Alas, Zahra's lonely son,\nwho rises and asks Fatima for water.\nThat thirsty Hussain lives within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: KARBOBALA WOH MAQTAL LAASHE WOH GHAR LUTANA\nBE PARDA QAID HOKAR ZAINAB KA SHAAM JANA\nSAB DEKHTI HAI FIZZA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: Karbala, the battlefield, the bodies and the plundered home;\nZainab taken bareheaded as a captive to Shaam—\nFizza sees all of it within Zahra's tears.

arabic text: KAISE KARIM LIKHU’N BIBI PE ZULM KI HAD\nZEESHAN ROZE MEHSHAR DEKENGE KHUD MUHAMAD\nDARBAAR ANA JAANA ZAHRA KE AANSUON ME
english translation text: O Karim, how can I write the limit of oppression upon the Lady?\nO Zeeshan, upon Resurrection Muhammad himself will see\nher going to and from the court within Zahra's tears.
